deviations_from_adr: A-1 tightened to include comment lines (reviewer changes_requested direction): ADR §4 stated 'не-комментарий строка' (non-comment line only). R-3 nit from adversarial review + explicit task direction to reject comment-only-line deletion caused tightening to byte-freeze ALL non-empty lines (including comments). Comment deletions in foreign frozen checks are now rejected by A-1. This is a security improvement; deviation recorded here per coder.md rule 4.

corpus_ref extraction regex broadened to handle non-hex values (SELFTEST_SKIP sentinel): original regex '[a-f0-9]+' only matched hex chars; expanded to generic string extraction then validated format separately. No behavioral change for production paths; self-test remains clean.

catalog_enforced_files awk redesigned to handle both Format A (standalone Enforced by line with blank separator) and Format B (inline - **Enforced by:** bullet) from the real T-0152 catalog. Original single-pass awk stopped at first blank line after 'Enforced by.' label, missing the bullet-point content. Fixed to collect all ci/checks/* paths within the family section block.
blocked_reason:
Bootstrap founder sanction required for frozen-checks-immutable.sh edit (UNCHANGED from original — the R-1 fix did not resolve this, as intended). frozen-checks-immutable.sh (owner T-0146) requires a one-time founder-class sanction line in ci/checks/data/frozen-sanctions.jsonl before the bootstrap edit (FF-FCI13 elif branch) can pass the meta-gate. This is the single --self-bind paradox documented in ADR §2-Q1: the mechanism that introduces auto_additive class cannot self-sanction its own bootstrap edit.

Required founder action: append one founder-class sanction line via founder_decide and add to frozen-sanctions.jsonl:
{"task":"T-0232","file":"ci/checks/frozen-checks-immutable.sh","owner":"T-0146","decision":"founder_decide@DATE","sanctioned_by":"founder","note":"bootstrap: one-time additive thaw adding FF-FCI13 elif branch (auto_additive class) to meta-gate; founder-path FF-FCI12 behaviorally equivalent (SANCTION byte-identical, AUDIT additively gains class=founder per AC-7); installs D-060 auto-sanction mechanism; ADR T-0232 §2-Q1"}

After this line is appended, frozen-checks-immutable.sh will verify FF-FCI13 (the edit is additive: new elif branch beside existing founder branch; founder path is behaviorally equivalent) and the branch can be merged.

r1_fix_summary.r1a_corpus_ref_ancestor_check: IMPLEMENTED: attestation_valid now requires corpus_ref to be (1) a valid git sha (7-40 hex chars or SELFTEST_SKIP sentinel), (2) an ancestor of HEAD via git merge-base --is-ancestor, AND (3) resolve to the same corpus.jsonl blob as HEAD. A stale sha that is reachable but not ancestor-of-HEAD → REJECTED. A sha with a different corpus blob → REJECTED. Only a current ancestor with matching blob passes.
r1_fix_summary.r1b_families_bound_to_file: IMPLEMENTED: attestation_valid now accepts optional thawed_file arg. When provided (--verify mode and standalone mode), each declared family must have its Enforced-by section in T-0152 catalog reference the thawed file (by basename match). A thaw of object-handle-isolation.sh citing TENANT-ISO (which only covers cross-tenant-fitness.sh) → REJECTED. New catalog_enforced_files() function handles both catalog formats.
r1_fix_summary.comment_deletion_tightened: A-1 no longer skips comment lines (reviewer direction + R-3). All non-empty lines (including comments) are now byte-frozen. Comment-only-line deletion is REJECTED by A-1.

R-1-BOUND-FAMILY-POSITIVE: attestation with OBJECT-HANDLE-ISO for object-handle-isolation.sh (correctly covered in catalog) → ACCEPTED
